name: Wind Chime With Slate Stone
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from a combination of natural slate stone, metal tubes, wooden top piece, nylon rope, and durable hanging strings for a balanced and decorative wind chime design.
    - The hanging ornament is made from 5mm thick slate stone, offering a sturdy, natural-looking surface with a rustic memorial-style appearance.
    - Features durable metal tubes that help create soft, soothing chime sounds when moved by the wind.
    - Designed with a wooden top cap and strong rope structure for stable hanging and everyday decorative use.
    - Combines natural texture, elegant sound, and personalized keepsake value in one meaningful display piece.
    - Suitable for both decorative and remembrance purposes indoors or outdoors.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Slate stone ornament options:
            +) Heart Slate Stone: 10 x 10 cm ~ 3.94 x 3.94 in
            +) Round Slate Stone: 10 x 10 cm ~ 3.94 x 3.94 in
    - Overall wind chime height: 58 cm
    - Top wooden piece diameter: 10.5 cm
    - Metal tube diameter: 1.5 cm
    📌 Note: The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customise only the printed design.
     
  • Engraving & Printing Technology:
    - This product supports:
            +) UV Printing
            +) Laser Engraving
    - UV Printing provides vivid colors, clear image quality, and a more decorative full-color finish.
    - Laser Engraving creates a subtle etched effect with a refined memorial-style appearance.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a decorative wind chime and a personalized memorial keepsake.
    - Suitable for patios, porches, balconies, gardens, windows, memorial corners, and indoor remembrance displays.
    - Great for honoring beloved pets or loved ones in a soft and meaningful way.
    - Adds both visual charm and peaceful sound to the surrounding space.
    - Lightweight enough for hanging display while still offering a solid decorative presence.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful personalized gift for pet lovers, family members, friends, and anyone remembering a beloved companion.
    - Perfect for pet memorials, sympathy gifts, remembrance occasions, anniversaries of loss, and heartfelt tribute moments.
    - Ideal for creating a peaceful memorial display at home or in the garden.
    - Great for anyone who values meaningful keepsakes with both emotional and decorative significance.
    - A beautiful remembrance gift that combines natural materials, personalized detail, and gentle sound 🕊️

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Wind Chime With Slate Stone

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
